name: frontends-are-separate-projects
body: The frontend crates are separate projects, so each crate's e2e tests live in that crate's own `tests/` directory — `src/pylib/tests/`, `src/structlib/tests/` — rather than in the root crate's `tests/`. The phrase "top-level `tests/`" means a crate's own top-level `tests/` directory, per crate; each frontend crate's e2e tests are selected by the `e2e::` substring filter within that crate's own test invocation. Every first-party crate that carries inline tests needing white-box access has its own library surface (lib target) so its tests move out of the production module tree: the root `apg` crate, `structlib` and `pylib` — the two frontend crates carrying inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` modules, holding `rust.structfrontend.tests.*` and `rust.pyfrontend.tests.*`. The other frontends keep their tests in separate files by language convention (`src/javalib/CallGraphBuilderTest.java`, `src/golib/main_test.go`, `src/csharplib/tests/Program.cs`, `src/tslib/scanner.test.ts`), so their tests already live in separate files and require zero lib-target change.
